# apple_sandbox_testers (Data Source)

Lists the account's sandbox testers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_sandbox_testers" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `sandbox_testers` (Attributes List) The sandbox testers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sandbox_testers))

<a id="nestedatt--sandbox_testers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sandbox_testers`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address of the sandbox Apple Account.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the tester.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `territory` (String) Storefront, e.g. `USA`.
